description:
Rank sites imaged more than once, before a change tool is pointed at one.

    Use this when the site is not already known. Each site's ``hrefs`` are that
    site's STAC URLs, oldest first, ready for ``pick_change_interval``,
    ``change_composite``, or ``stack_stats``. Prefer this, or
    ``search_catalog(area=..., fuzzy=True)``, over ``semantic=True`` when the
    name shares words with a task. No model is called.

    Argument reference (ranking, recency, cadence, baseline, return fields):
    https://umbra-py.space/find-repeat-sites/

    Filters bound which acquisitions are ranked. ``bbox`` is WGS84
    ``[min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat]``. ``intersects`` is one GeoJSON
    Point, or a Polygon or MultiPolygon (or a Feature, FeatureCollection, or
    GeometryCollection wrapping those). A point matches footprints that
    contain it. It cannot be combined with ``bbox`` or ``place``. ``place`` is geocoded
    only when ``bbox`` is omitted. ``area`` is a task-name substring;
    ``fuzzy=True`` is a deterministic loose match. ``start`` / ``end`` bound
    which passes enter the pool (ISO date, bare year or month, or a relative
    expression). ``products`` is any of GEC, CSI, SIDD, SICD, CPHD.
    ``polarizations``, ``min_incidence``, ``max_incidence``, and
    ``max_resolution`` (metres) drop passes missing that field.

    ``top`` (default 20) is how many sites to return. ``min_passes`` (default
    2) is the minimum depth: comparable passes when ``rank_by`` is
    ``comparable``, otherwise raw dated passes. ``rank_by`` is ``passes``
    (default), ``comparable`` (largest same-polarization subset), ``recency``
    (newest pass), ``span`` (first to last), or ``cadence`` (tightest median
    gap). For the three temporal orders, ``min_passes`` still counts raw
    passes.

    ``active_since`` / ``active_before`` select sites by newest pass;
    ``first_since`` / ``first_before`` select by earliest pass. Those keep
    each survivor's full history, unlike ``start`` / ``end``, which truncate
    the pool. ``max_revisit_days`` caps the worst gap and
    ``median_revisit_days`` caps the median gap. ``min_span_days`` /
    ``max_span_days`` bound the first-to-last span. A non-positive cadence or
    span raises ``ValueError``. With ``rank_by="comparable"`` the cadence and
    span filters use that subset. A bare year or month on a ``*_before``
    bound includes the whole period.

    ``limit`` (default 500) sizes only a live or Canopy pool. A local index
    ranks each task over the whole index and ignores ``limit``. ``local``
    matches ``search_catalog``: unset uses the index when present. A Canopy
    token (``$UMBRA_CANOPY_TOKEN``) draws the pool from the commercial
    archive, and ``local=True`` cannot be combined with it.

active_before.description: Keep sites whose newest pass is on or before this date. A bare year or month includes that whole period.
active_before.title: Active Before

active_since.description: Keep sites whose newest pass is on or after this date. Same grammar as start.
active_since.title: Active Since

area.description: Pool filter: task-name substring. With fuzzy, a loose token match.
area.title: Area

bbox.description: Pool filter: WGS84 [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat]. When set, place is not geocoded.
bbox.title: Bbox

end.description: Pool filter: inclusive upper bound on which passes are counted. Same grammar as start.
end.title: End

first_before.description: Keep sites whose earliest pass is on or before this date. A bare year or month includes that whole period.
first_before.title: First Before

first_since.description: Keep sites whose earliest pass is on or after this date. Same grammar as start.
first_since.title: First Since

fuzzy.description: Loose task-name match for area. No model call.
fuzzy.title: Fuzzy

intersects.description: Pool filter: one GeoJSON Point, or a Polygon or MultiPolygon, optionally wrapped in a Feature, FeatureCollection, or GeometryCollection. A point matches footprints that contain it. Cannot be combined with bbox or place.
intersects.title: Intersects

limit.description: How many acquisitions to pull for a live or Canopy ranking. Default 500. Ignored on a local index, which groups the whole index.
limit.title: Limit

local.description: True uses only the local index; False forces a live walk. Omit to use the index when present. True cannot be combined with a Canopy token.
local.title: Local

max_incidence.description: Pool filter: maximum incidence angle in degrees. Passes missing it are dropped.
max_incidence.title: Max Incidence

max_resolution.description: Pool filter: keep passes this fine or finer, in metres. Missing resolution is dropped.
max_resolution.title: Max Resolution

max_revisit_days.description: Drop sites whose worst revisit gap exceeds this many days. Non-positive raises. Uses the comparable series when rank_by is comparable.
max_revisit_days.title: Max Revisit Days

max_span_days.description: Drop sites whose first-to-last span is longer than this many days. Non-positive raises. Uses the comparable series when rank_by is comparable.
max_span_days.title: Max Span Days

median_revisit_days.description: Drop sites whose median revisit gap exceeds this many days. Non-positive raises. Uses the comparable series when rank_by is comparable.
median_revisit_days.title: Median Revisit Days

min_incidence.description: Pool filter: minimum incidence angle in degrees. Passes missing it are dropped.
min_incidence.title: Min Incidence

min_passes.description: Minimum series depth. Default 2. Counts comparable passes when rank_by is comparable, otherwise raw dated passes.
min_passes.title: Min Passes

min_span_days.description: Drop sites whose first-to-last span is shorter than this many days. Non-positive raises. Uses the comparable series when rank_by is comparable.
min_span_days.title: Min Span Days

place.description: Pool filter: free-text place. Geocoded to a bbox only when bbox is omitted.
place.title: Place

polarizations.description: Pool filter: keep passes exposing any listed polarization. Missing values are dropped.
polarizations.title: Polarizations

products.description: Pool filter: keep passes that expose one of these types (GEC, CSI, SIDD, SICD, CPHD). Case-insensitive.
products.title: Products

rank_by.description: passes (default), comparable, recency, span, or cadence. Unknown values raise ValueError.
rank_by.title: Rank By

start.description: Pool filter: inclusive lower bound on which passes are counted. ISO date, bare year or month, or a relative expression.
start.title: Start

top.description: Maximum sites to return, best first. Default 20.
top.title: Top

name: find_repeat_sites
